subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should this PR require live TTS/Gateway proof before merge, or is targeted test and bundle evidence enough for this credential-routing fix?
rationale: The code path looks like the right shared fix, but the PR changes SecretRef credential routing and the contributor explicitly did not test the reported live TTS flow.

options.title: Require Live SecretRef TTS Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal or log output from openclaw infer tts convert or an equivalent Gateway TTS call using a file-source persona SecretRef before merge.

options.title: Accept Targeted Tests Only
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge on collector, registry, and command-target tests alone, accepting that the reported runtime provider path remains unproven.

recommendation.title: Require Live SecretRef TTS Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal or log output from openclaw infer tts convert or an equivalent Gateway TTS call using a file-source persona SecretRef before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant authored the adjacent SecretRef framework that this PR extends, so he is the best available owner for proof and credential-routing sufficiency.
